hypothesis_title: Iter 22 — STR_1701 Drawdown-Conditioned Defensive Factor Discovery
hypothesis_description:
Iter 22 — 사용자 핵심 제안. STR_1701이 무너지는 구간 정확히 방어하는 factor 발견.

## 동기 (사용자 인사이트, 9 sprint fail 본질 진단)
- 9 sprint 모두 unconditional cross-section alpha discovery → fail (L-211/225/228)
- Universe expansion / Time / Layer 모두 fail (L-227/230/231)
- 본질: STR_1701 drawdown 구간을 *조건부로* 방어하는 factor만 진정한 hedge
- AX-001 v2 conditional metric의 본질 — 위기 alpha + bad/normal IC ratio

## 핵심 가설 (Drawdown-Conditioned Alpha)
1. STR_1701 walk-forward NAV → drawdown periods 식별
   - threshold: rolling 6m return < -5% 또는 NAV from peak < -10%
2. 그 기간 cross-section alpha discovery (defensive characteristics)
3. 진정한 hedge: 평시 STR_1701 cor > 0 OR neutral, drawdown cor < -0.2
4. AX-001 v2 conditional metric mandatory: crisis_alpha + bad/normal IC ratio + Core MDD relief

## Defensive Factor 후보 (Alpha 자율 선택)
1. **Q07 Earnings Stability + Q25 Ohlson_O** (PG2 STR_1656 inheritance 강화)
2. **Low beta** (rolling 60d β vs KOSPI200, t-1)
3. **High dividend yield** (DPS/Price 12m forward, DART CFO 5월 lag)
4. **Defensive sector tilt** (utilities/telecom/consumer staples 비중)
5. **Cash flow stability** (DART CFO 5y std / 5y mean)
6. **Earnings revision positive** (consensus revision momentum)
7. **Tail-conditioned momentum reversal** (drawdown 시 mean-reversion)

## 9 Sprint 학습 BLOCKING (모두 회피)
- L-211: KR linear composite fail
- L-220: vol-reduction Harvey 격하
- L-223: universe restriction alpha vanishing
- L-225: sigmoid joint fail

## 본 sprint 차별성 (vs 8 sprint cycle)
- 차원: **Conditional regime** (STR_1701 NAV drawdown = specific subsample)
- alpha: defensive factors only — drawdown 구간에서 positive return
- 비교: 평시 STR_1701과 무관 또는 약한 cor BUT drawdown 구간 -0.2 이하
- AX-001 v2 4-metric 본질 평가 (Iter 11 R2 finalize precedent)

- alpha_inheritance_hash N/A (새 alpha source)

- V22 ↔ STR_1701 평시 cor: -0.30 ≤ cor ≤ 0.30 (지장 없음)
- V22 ↔ STR_1701 drawdown cor: < -0.20 (진정한 hedge)
- AX-001 v2 4-metric:
  - crisis_alpha: > 0.10 (drawdown 구간 alpha)
  - Core MDD relief: V22 추가 시 PG2 MDD 완화 ≥ 5pp
  - bad/normal IC ratio: bad regime IC / normal regime IC > 1.5
